svg.title: Where the track is today
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map of today. Rust track runs on the OCR line, an opt-in Rust track on the Messages line, and dirt roads on Responses and Chat completions. The Gate, Router and Ledger are wooden Python stations. Cache, Vault and Post office are construction sites with crab builders. Customs and the HTTP tunnel are finished Rust. The OCR train still has to send a wagon down the dirt spur to the Cache.
svg.text: OCR runs on Rust track, but still unloads onto a wagon at every Python station. Most stations are under construction.
